class.name: WorldMountainRangeDecorator
class.brief_description: Builds mountains from discrete summits and a connected ridge graph.
class.description: Uses seeded summit points in wavelength-sized world tiles, shared neighbour connections, broad compact mountain bodies and ridges with saddles. summit_count controls points per tile, ridge_width is a fraction of tile scale, and detail_strength adds restrained flank grooves and small noise. This is an analytic structural prototype, not simulated erosion or a graph fitted to an exact biome polygon. Set world_space_noise for continuity across templates; biome edge ramps control the enclosing mountain area. Shared elevation, seed, composition, material and interior controls are inherited from [WorldTerrainDecorator].
